maria: Heads up — I rolled a small int8 canary (raven-lite-int8) to staging and ran a 10k req simulated replay. Seeing ~0.9% structured-output parse failures that only show up under sustained concurrent traffic.

josh: Can you paste the failing payload logs? is it trailing-comma, truncated stream, or wrong field type?

maria: pasted a short example below, it's weirdly interleaved with KV prefix fragments when batch_size>=8. repro snippet: `curl -XPOST /invoke -d @payload.json`

josh: log excerpt: ```
2026-03-20T18:12:03Z ERROR parse_json: Unexpected token ',' at byte 1024
model=raven-lite-int8 kernel=nvf
request_id=rcp-8822
input_len=2048
kv_prefix=partial
```

anika: :eyes: sounds like a streaming boundary vs batching interaction. Could be tokenizer split across micro-batches + quantized model output shift. Two quick mitigations: 1) wrap responses in an outer sentinel ("<JSON_START>...<JSON_END>") in the canary path, 2) increase per-request retry_budget for the canary to hide transient truncation.

maria: tried sentinel wrapping in the canary; reduced failures to 0.2% but still some malformed arrays (missing closing bracket) under peak qps.

josh: note that our KV cache coalesces prefixes across concurrent requests — if the runtime merges prefix buffers incorrectly for int8 codepath that'd explain interleaved suffixes. I can add extra isolation for the canary (disable prefix caching) and re-run.

runtime-bot: deploy 1723456792 by josh: canary isolation toggle applied to raven-lite-int8 (prefix_cache=false) — status: success.

maria: re-ran replay after toggle, failures dropped to 0.03% (mostly noise). attaching sample failing output: `{"action": "search", "params": [1,2` (missing `]}`)

sre-oncall: we should add an SLO alert for structured-output-parse-rate > 0.1% per 5m on staging canaries. also add a log-fronting rule to capture raw token stream for later bisect.

anika: action items: (a) add test harness that replays production-like interleaving at token-level (not just HTTP-level), (b) iterate quant kernel test to compare tokenization boundary behavior int8 vs fp16, (c) harden parser with a lightweight repair step that tries to append closing brackets and reparse once before failing.

josh: i'll own (a) and (b), create a small runner that drives multiple parallel websockets to exercise the streaming path. maria, can you prototype the repair-step in the SDK?

maria: yes, will prototype in the SDK as opt-in for canaries. will also flip the canary to dedicated isolation while we finish.

anika: good. if repair-step reduces errors without masking real regressions, we can promote it to default with telemetry. also we should add a unit test that simulates half-token flushes at random offsets.

sre-oncall: created alert: staging/structured-output-parse-rate > 0.1% (1723456810). tagging the thread.

maria: thanks — next run scheduled in 30m. will post results.:thumbsup:
